text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Brewed by yours truly, the Class Rep's 
Special Nutritious Tea! Please drink it 
right up before it gets cold!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... Wow, it's so warmâand 
deliciousâª

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"No. It's just that after that race, you 
seemed quite exhausted, so I thought—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your true ability goes far beyond that. I 
do not wish to see you run like that 
again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Therefore! I thought I'd revitalize you 
with Bakushin energy using the 
nutrient-packed tea I drink regularly!! 
That is why!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Next time for sure—it made me feel that 
way.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, quite so, quite so!! Now then, how 
about seconds?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... In that case, I'll take you up on 
that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me!! I shall brew it at full 
bakushin speed!!
